sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:60

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:60:1
items.html: And after the male’s Gadlut, the twelve years and one day of the female’s Gadlut begin: For it is impossible for the Katnut of the lower to come out before the Gadlut of the upper is completed. As written above (page 739, the passage beginning “And this matter”), the AHP of the upper are always found with the GE of the lower in one degree. Therefore, if the upper has not yet sorted out and corrected his own AHP, how much more so will he be unable to correct the GE of the lower. Therefore ZA cannot enlarge the Katnut of the Nukva, namely her GE, before he attains his own Gadlut — namely the bringing down of the bottom Hey from his Einayim, which returns the AHP to their degree. Then his AHP become the discernment of a vessel that raises MAN and corrects the GE of the Nukva, as written there. And what the ARI writes, “the twelve years and one day of the female’s Gadlut,” does not mean actual Gadlut, for the duration of the twelve years is only for the Katnut of the female, as the ARI writes below, that throughout this whole time she is called a minor. Rather, the intent is to enlarge the building of her Katnut alone, and the word “Gadlut” is from the language of the enlarging of the female. For up to now, the discernment of the MAN of the Nukva, from the standpoint of what pertains to her own building, had no form at all, for she served only in the discernment of a screen for the sake of the level of the male, as above: at first for the level of Yesod, and afterwards for the level of Tifferet, namely for the level of HGT. But now, after ZA has already received his level of Gadlut, the time begins in which he can correct the discernment of the Katnut of the female, as above at length.
